study type: Interpretive description qualitative analysis (web-based survey and semi-structured interviews)
exposure: experiences of mistreatment during maternity care
cohort: The study included adult women with a history of caesarean who had a subsequent birth of any mode in the United States within 5 years preceding study participation.
finding: Participants described all eight types of mistreatment, with marginalised participants being most likely to describe these experiences, leading to consequences such as healthcare system distrust and maternal mental health complications.
cross-section timing: Data collected related to births occurring within 5 years preceding study participation.
